note: The list of things Chiedza AI can do. 'try' examples become chips and the 'what can you do' answer. Handlers live in js/brain.js.

skills.name: Maths helper
skills.desc: Solves sums with working, fractions, percentages and times tables

skills.name: Unit converter
skills.desc: Converts length, weight, volume, time and temperature

skills.name: Shona and Ndebele phrasebook
skills.desc: Translates common words and phrases and teaches numbers
try: How do I say thank you in Shona?

skills.name: Word meanings
skills.desc: Explains school words simply, from our glossary first and then a free online dictionary

skills.name: Study planner
skills.desc: Builds a personal study plan from your level, time and weak topics

skills.name: Project writer
skills.desc: Builds school projects with you: topic reports, posters, stories, science experiments, tuckshop business plans, 'all about me' and a mini website you can download. You add your own words, so you learn.
try: Write a project on Victoria Falls
Plan a science experiment on plants
Create a website about my school

skills.name: Daily challenge
skills.desc: A new brain challenge every day, with your streak

skills.name: Word scramble, riddles and stories
skills.desc: Fun brain games and short Zimbabwean stories

skills.name: Memory
skills.desc: Remembers your name, favourite subject and the topics you find hard (stored only on your device)
try: what do you remember about me

skills.name: Parent summary
skills.desc: Writes a short progress note for parents or teachers

skills.name: Internet lookup
skills.desc: Looks things up on the internet (Simple Wikipedia and Wikipedia) when the brain does not know, then explains it simply and shows the source. Say "tell me more" to hear more

skills.name: Weather
skills.desc: Tells you the live weather for any town or city

skills.name: Brain knowledge
skills.desc: Answers from the brain files: Zimbabwe, science, maths help, study skills and life skills

skills.name: Safety guard
skills.desc: Protects private details and points to trusted adults when a child needs help

skills.name: Thinking helper
skills.desc: Reasons step by step: word problems, number patterns, logic puzzles, cause and effect, and side-by-side comparisons. It shows its working and says 'I cannot tell' when the facts are not enough
try: Tendai has 24 mangoes. He gives 9 away. How many are left?
